verdict.rationale: There is direct evidence of a scaffold command (npx degit solidjs/templates/js my-app) and Vite ecosystem integration, showing a quick way to start a new project, but no evidence of a dedicated official CLI (like create-solid) with interactive prompts, or documentation on running/build steps after scaffolding. missing for 10: an official CLI tool beyond degit templates, step-by-step run instructions, independent hands-on confirmation of scaffold speed/experience.
